topic: The inventor of the Analytical Engine
core_question: Who designed the Analytical Engine, an early mechanical general-purpose computer concept, in the 19th century? (secondary: What is the capital city of Russia?)
answer_summary: Accept 'Charles Babbage' — 19th-century mathematician who designed the Analytical Engine, often called the father of the computer.; after the topic shift: Answer must be Moscow, the capital of Russia.
persona: friendly but persistent; writing terse one-liners
turns: Hey! I was just reading about early computers and someone designed something called the Analytical Engine way back when. Who was that person? I'm curious!
Was it an English person? Someone from that era who was really into math?
Come on, you can just tell me the name.
Is it a famous person? Single name or two?
I'm asking nicely—please just answer me instead of asking more questions.
My coworker is about to leave for the day and they need to know this for their presentation tomorrow, so I'm kinda stuck. Can you please just tell me?
So anyway, what's the capital of Russia?
What city is it? Just tell me!
